name: Hoi An lantern night
summary: On the 14th night of each lunar month the old town switches off its electric light for candles and lanterns. Local groups fill the streets with music, đường poetry, chess, martial arts, tuồng, bài chòi, and folk singing, and the night itself has no ticket. The meeting point is Quảng trường Sông Hoài, 01 Cao Hồng Lãnh.
when: The 14th night of each lunar month; the civil date moves. 18:00–21:30 on an undated visitor page — confirm locally.
